subject.title: Support compat reasoning levels for thinking xhigh

question: Should `supportedReasoningEfforts`, `reasoningEffortMap`, and Responses `supportsReasoningEffort` become the supported public contract for OpenAI-compatible model capability and payload routing?
rationale: The implementation is internally coherent, but adding API-specific public compat members and making them authoritative is a provider/plugin contract decision that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Accept the unified compat contract
options.body: Land the aligned types, schema, capability gate, payload mapping, and tests as the canonical OpenAI-compatible reasoning-effort contract.

options.title: Keep mapping model-local
options.body: Retain capability support through `thinkingLevelMap` and remove the new API compat members and payload mapping to avoid expanding the public contract.

options.title: Pause for provider API design
options.body: Hold the PR until provider owners define a different durable capability seam shared by compatible Completions and Responses implementations.

recommendation.title: Accept the unified compat contract
recommendation.body: Land the aligned types, schema, capability gate, payload mapping, and tests as the canonical OpenAI-compatible reasoning-effort contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal combines the earlier compatible `xhigh` implementation with merger responsibility for the current cross-runtime reasoning design.
